title: Forty-five stages found no negative proposal and six hit a limit
statement: Bounded search on UNMODIFIED Jr uses r3/4,1,2,1/10,10;24unoriented frequencies coordinatebound3,sine/cosine andboth outputs,96realcoefficients.16x16periodic quadrature integrates degree-four trigonometric support exactly in exact arithmetic (maxcoordinatefrequency12),but actual run is floating. On full-covariance interior,affine mean elimination f-v^T K^-1v/2 uses f=<F0(G)>,v=<DF0(G)>,K=<F0_doubleprime(G)>;ROC/actual rank-one Fourier decomposition earns PSD,not arbitrary inverse at a singular boundary. Covariance barriers1e-3,1e-5,0 and finite-difference envelope-gradient checks remain diagnostics. First scale-invariant L-BFGS drifted to huge raw coefficient norms and stalled (~4.75506s). Corrected unit-coefficient-norm SLSQP ran45stages (~31.99644s),six iteration limits,no negative proposal;smallest normalized residual~.06286597234 at r1/10 is local finite outcome,NOT global lower bound/QC evidence. r1 is already known QC positive control. Both complete search records/logs retained. Original general-U QC,full attainable capacity and separation remain unresolved.
